test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A room in a public building where outdoor clothes or luggage may be left
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cloakroom**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **cloakroom** is a room in a public building where people can leave their outdoor clothes or luggage.
 
• Therefore, option 2) is the correct one-word substitute for the given group of words.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Meanings of the incorrect options:
 
 
• 1) **Cemetery** - a place where dead people are buried.
 
• 2) **Courtyard** - an open space surrounded by walls or buildings, typically in a castle or palace.
 
• 3) **Hangar** - a large building with an extensive floor area, typically for housing aircraft or spacecraft.
